subject: Web Development
title: IPFS: Content Without Servers
description: One-minute skill: IPFS: Content Without Servers.

hook.text: On today's web, if a server goes down, the content disappears. IPFS fixes that.

buildup.text: IPFS addresses content by its hash, not its location. The same file can exist on many nodes.

discovery.text: If one node goes offline, others still serve the content. No single point of failure.

twist.text: IPFS is slow for dynamic content and requires nodes willing to store your data.

climax.text: IPFS shows a future where content lives forever — if the ecosystem solves its incentive problems.

punchline.text: Address content by what it is, not where it lives.

quiz.question: How does IPFS address content?
options: By content hash, not server location
